facts.value: Rendering begins only when the Ground object's camera-selector bits equal the current Camera selector. If the Ground has an associated GObj that differs from the current render object, drawing additionally requires the Ground override flag, a valid camera GObj and CObj, and that CObj being current; without an associated GObj, a Ground predicate on the current render object can suppress drawing. A final pair of Camera predicates must also permit rendering. Once admitted, the callback optionally disables fog, invalidates cached GX state, chooses specialized versus standard JObj rendering from a Ground flag, and then conditionally restores the stage fog. It maintains no timer or action-state transition of its own.
